text: PREFACE Biological Science is a very vast sub'ect that deals with Botany, Zoology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Genetic, Cytology, Ecology, Embryology, Physiology, Histology, Anatomy, Taxanomy etc. It also included the related branches like Bioinformatics, Agriculture, Horiticulture microbiology besides microscopy and microtomy.
text_raw:
PREFACE 
Biological Science is a very vast sub'ect that deals with Botany, 
Zoology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Genetic, Cytology, Ecology, 
Embryology, Physiology, Histology, Anatomy, Taxanomy etc. It also included 
the related branches like Bioinformatics, Agriculture, Horiticulture microbiology 
besides microscopy and microtomy.
